# Onboarding service step — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the onboarding service step when the wizard needs to ask which service: the service-catalog preset step over the picker plan mode. `services` is the injected standard service catalog — data in, never a local copy, mapped to picker options and nothing else — and the canonical selection trio carries the chosen service out to the wizard. There is no second plan selector: plan choosing converges on the picker's plan mode and this step is its preset rather than a fork. Services render through the picker plan mode, so options announce with the picker's listbox contract, with `label` and `placeholder` naming the step's picker and `description` carrying the supporting line.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the onboarding service step when the wizard needs to ask which service: the service-catalog preset step over the picker plan mode — the native twin under the same contract. `services` is the injected standard service catalog — data in, never a local copy, mapped to picker options and nothing else — and the canonical selection trio carries the chosen service out to the wizard. There is no second plan selector: plan choosing converges on the picker's plan mode and this step is its preset rather than a fork. Services render through the picker plan mode, so options announce with the picker's contract, with `label` and `placeholder` naming the step's picker and `description` carrying the supporting line.
